name: flow_duel_member_ready_with_too_many
description: A member of an Undertow party that grew past a duel's two (design 1.4, 5.2): only the leader's Start waits for the party to be two again ('A duel is one against one'); a member still says Ready and Not ready meanwhile, and the server hears it, so a Ready member can take it back while the third is there.

steps.assert: not Session.is_leader() and node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Ready' and not node('Primary').disabled
steps.msg: a member of a duel of two: Ready

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Ready' and not node('Primary').disabled and node('PrimaryLine').text == 'A duel is one against one'
steps.msg: three are more than a duel holds, but a member may still say Ready

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Not ready' and not node('Primary').disabled and node('PrimaryLine').text == 'A duel is one against one'
steps.msg: Ready heard: Not ready, while the party is three
and Not ready takes it back

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Ready' and node('PrimaryLine').text != 'A duel is one against one'
